limitations: This is not effective deployed permission state.
Conditional inserts, later UPDATE or DELETE statements, built-in policies, and operator-created policies may change effective access.
Field lists do not establish row, relation, hook, or runtime-role parity.
No database, credentials, Directus provider, or business records are read.
scope: literal INSERT declarations in the curated Directus SQL seed

source_mutations.statement: UPDATE directus_permissions SET permissions = '{"_and":[{"status":{"_in":["verified","published"]}},{"is_public":{"_eq":true}},{"consent_given":{"_eq":true}},{"party_id":{"_nnull":true}}]}', fields = 'id,location_id,farm_id,feedback_type,stakeholder_group,feedback_date,sentiment,themes,public_summary,evidence_maturity' WHERE policy = 'b1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005' AND collection = 'stakeholder_feedback' AND action = 'read'

UPDATE directus_permissions SET fields = 'id,name,description,dataset_type,location_id,query_id,refresh_interval_minutes,last_refreshed_at,status,metadata,created_at,updated_at,updated_by' WHERE policy = 'b1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000009' AND collection = 'dashboard_dataset' AND action = 'read' AND fields = '*'

UPDATE directus_permissions SET fields = 'id,metric_id,location_id,period_start,period_end,value,unit,computation_method,computed_at,verified,verified_at' WHERE policy = 'b1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000009' AND collection = 'metric_value' AND action = 'read' AND fields = '*'
UPDATE directus_permissions SET permissions = next_filter::JSON WHERE id = legacy_permission.id
UPDATE directus_permissions SET permissions = '{}'::JSON WHERE id = legacy_permission.id

UPDATE directus_permissions SET validation = '{}'::JSON WHERE policy = 'b1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND action = 'create' AND collection IN ('harvest_event', 'expense_event', 'stakeholder_feedback', 'metric_proposal') AND validation::JSONB = '{"location_id":{"_eq":"$CURRENT_USER.location_id"}}'::JSONB
